From 76c023fac32a191c51b16d811b1a311a827691f6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>
Date: Tue, 12 Oct 2021 11:21:24 -0400
Subject: [PATCH] drm/amdgpu/smu11: fix firmware version check for vangogh

Was missed in the conversion to IP version checking.

Fixes: af3b89d3a639d5 ("drm/amdgpu/smu11.0: convert to IP version checking")
Reviewed-by: Evan Quan <evan.quan@amd.com>
Signed-off-by: Alex Deucher <alexander.deucher@amd.com>

diff --git a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c
index aa4d34f35c33..5c1703cc25fd 100644
--- a/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c
+++ b/drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c
@@ -255,7 +255,7 @@ int smu_v11_0_check_fw_version(struct smu_context *smu)
 	case IP_VERSION(11, 0, 11):
 		smu->smc_driver_if_version = SMU11_DRIVER_IF_VERSION_Navy_Flounder;
 		break;
-	case CHIP_VANGOGH:
+	case IP_VERSION(11, 5, 0):
 		smu->smc_driver_if_version = SMU11_DRIVER_IF_VERSION_VANGOGH;
 		break;
 	case IP_VERSION(11, 0, 12):
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/gpu/drm/amd/pm/swsmu/smu11/smu_v11_0.c`**
   - The case for `CHIP_VANGOGH` was changed from `case CHIP_VANGOGH:` to `case IP_VERSION(11, 5, 0):`.
   - This modification updates the firmware version check for the Vangogh chip to use the correct IP version.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in the `smu_v11_0.c` file addresses a bug related to the firmware version check for the Vangogh chip. It corrects the case statement to ensure that the appropriate IP version (11.5.0) is checked instead of the previous incorrect identifier (`CHIP_VANGOGH`). This change is part of a broader effort to convert to IP version checking, as indicated by the reference to a previous commit that introduced this conversion. The fix ensures that the driver correctly identifies and handles the firmware version for the Vangogh chip, thereby improving the functionality and reliability of the driver.
